GTA 6 is almost here, 13 years after GTA 5. Here’s what you need to know.
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on November 19. Here's everything you need to know ahead of its launch.
articles.txt:

Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on November 19. Here's everything you need to know ahead of its launch. (Rockstar) A little over 13 years after GTA 5 first hit consoles in 2013, Grand Theft Auto 6 is nearly here. Given the gargantuan success of its predecessor , this is likely to be the biggest game launch of the decade. GTA 6 , which will let players freely roam and explore the fictional state of Leonida – essentially a Florida analog – may also turn out to be the most expensive game ever made .
If you're thinking about joining in on the frenzy right at launch, we've rounded up everything you need to know to get started.
Grand Theft Auto 6 launches globally on November 19, 2026, placing it squarely in the busy holiday shopping season. The game has been delayed a couple of times in the past, but there's no sign of that happening again this close to release.
If you pre-order digitally, you'll be able to start playing right at midnight local time on November 19. The initial launch will only feature the single-player story mode, so don't expect to be able to jump into online multiplayer right away.
At launch, GTA 6 will only be available for current-generation game consoles. That means you can only play it on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X or Xbox Series S. While we've seen some other modern games also launch on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, GTA 6 is skipping them altogether due to the high technical demands of the game's world and systems.
GTA 6 (PlayStation 5) $80 at Amazon GTA 6 (Xbox Series X|S) $80 at Amazon How much does GTA 6 cost? GTA 6 is a little more expensive than normal new game releases, coming in at $80 for the standard edition. For diehard fans, there's also the Ultimate Edition and a physical Collector's bundle that, weirdly, doesn't include the game. Here's how it breaks down.
Standard Edition ($79.99): Includes the complete base game with the full single-player campaign. Available both digitally and in physical stores.
Ultimate Edition ($99.99): Exclusive to digital platforms. Includes the full game, alongside bonus cosmetics, in-game vehicles and property vouchers for online play.
Collector's bundle ($399.99) : Officially called "Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection," this bundle doesn't include a game code. However, it packs a lot of physical collectibles that GTA fans will enjoy, including a Macca the Gator figure, Oakley sunglasses, a snapback hat and more.
There's an important caveat, however, if you're planning to buy a physical copy in stores. The game box doesn't include a disc. Instead, you'll get a digital code that you can redeem on your console's store.
Yes! If you pre-order GTA 6 before its November 19 launch, you'll get the Vintage Vice City pack. It includes various retro-inspired Vice City cosmetics, along with an exclusive car, the '55 Vapid Stanier. It also includes one free month of GTA+.
GTA 6 takes place in the fictional state of Leonida, which includes Vice City.
Rockstar hasn't provided an exact file size yet, though that's something game developers usually disclose ahead of launch. Expect more details as we get closer to the release date. One thing's for sure, though: it's going to be large.
GTA 6 is going to be the biggest GTA game yet, encompassing the entire state of Leonida. It's also a fully modern game with high-end assets, physics and more. Expect it to require a lot of space on your console's storage drive, likely 150 GB or more.
Thankfully, if you have a slower internet connection, you'll be able to start pre-loading the game a week ahead of launch on November 12, 2026. If you buy the game digitally and have automatic downloads turned on, your console should start loading it once the option is available. If you pre-order a physical box, you'll have to wait until it arrives. However, if you get it early, you should be able to redeem the code and load the game ahead of time.
Not at launch. In typical Rockstar fashion, a PC version of GTA 6 is expected to arrive later, though the developer hasn't given an exact release date. However, rumors suggest it could be in the first three months of 2027 . If you're planning to wait for a PC launch, expect some pretty heavy system requirements when it lands.
GTA 6 Online won't be available at launch, but it's expected to arrive in 2027.

articles.t: GTA 6: pourquoi le nouveau trailer ne profite pas du très vanté upscaler de Sony ?
articles.chapeau: Le récent trailer de lancement de GTA 6 dévoile des graphismes exceptionnels mais fait l'impasse sur la nouvelle technologie de mise à l'échelle de Sony. Les analyses techniques confirment un rendu na
articles.txt:
Lire sur mobile Le récent trailer de lancement de GTA 6 dévoile des graphismes exceptionnels mais fait l'impasse sur la nouvelle technologie de mise à l'échelle de Sony. Les analyses techniques confirment un rendu natif en 1440p sans cette aide logicielle, jugée trop gourmande en ressources, tandis que le duo électro français Justice s'occupe d'une bande-son qui s'annonce déjà monumentale. Le célèbre studio américain a récemment dévoilé une séquence de 90 secondes de GTA 6, confirmant une sortie attendue pour le 19 novembre. Si la qualité visuelle globale impressionne par sa densité, l'analyse minutieuse des images capturées sur console révèle une approche technique très conservatrice. L'outil d'amélioration d'image par intelligence artificielle pourtant très vanté par Sony est totalement absent du flux vidéo. En parallèle de cette curiosité visuelle, la firme officialise une collaboration musicale d'envergure pour rythmer l'aventure de ses millions de futurs joueurs.
Les experts s'attendaient à voir la puissance logicielle qu QSR de Sony en action dès les premières secondes. Pourtant, le traitement d'image par QSSR (une technique d'upscaling propulsée par intelligence artificielle) brille par son absence. Sur la PS5 , ce silence technologique intrigue d'autant plus que le constructeur vante activement les mérites de cette fonctionnalité à tout va. Il semble que la gourmandise de cet algorithme refroidisse pourtant certains studios tiers.
Avec un objectif d'affichage fixé en 1440p natif, le moteur graphique monopolise déjà l'essentiel des capacités de calcul. Intégrer cet outil complexe coûterait environ 4 millisecondes sur un budget total de 33 ms, ce qui représente un sacrifice bien trop lourd pour un bénéfice marginal à l'écran. Les équipes de conception ont préféré allouer ces précieuses ressources à la physique du jeu et aux détails des décors. Il faut dire que GTA 6 s'annonce comme un monde ouvert qui fourmille de détails, il faut donc chercher l'optimisation au maximum.
Les précédentes vidéos promotionnelles avaient laissé les puristes sur leur faim avec d'étranges saccades dans les déplacements. Un rythme d'animation parfois hasardeux entachait la perception globale de l'œuvre. Sur ce nouveau montage de Grand Theft Auto VI , ces défauts du moteur interne semblent enfin appartenir au passé. Les mouvements respirent avec beaucoup plus de naturel.
Let's analyze tonemapping in GTA 6! Launch trailer is SDR but still gives us insight into how they are working with colors. Overall, what I see looks nice. Nothing appears particularly broken with one big exception. Gradients are smooth. Skin tones are great. Hue paths/shifts… pic.twitter.com/Kzlhd3agfO
La fluidité des déplacements des foules est désormais irréprochable. Même lors des lents panoramiques d'ambiance ou des scènes d'action frénétiques , le rendu global reste parfaitement cohérent. L'attente prolongée valait visiblement le coup pour peaufiner l'optimisation visuelle . C'est un soulagement majeur pour les joueurs qui redoutaient de retrouver les vieilles tares techniques des précédents épisodes.
La dimension sonore de cette aventure n'a pas été reléguée au second plan, bien au contraire. Le groupe électro emblématique Justice prend officiellement la direction de la partition originale. Leur premier extrait dévoilé, fusionnant les talents d'artistes internationaux prestigieux, garantit une ambiance urbaine électrique .
Le panorama musical s'annonce d'une richesse intense avec au total 34 morceaux exclusifs intégrés à la tracklist de lancement. Entre stations de radio virtuelles finement curatées et compositions instrumentales, le travail d'habillage sonore s'annonce pharaonique.
Les analyses techniques de la vidéo pointent vers une résolution de base en 1440p. L'image est ensuite étirée vers la 4K sans utiliser les derniers algorithmes de mise à l'échelle par intelligence artificielle de la console.
Le lancement mondial de l'aventure est programmé pour le 19 novembre sur les plateformes de salon actuelles, marquant le point culminant d'une attente longue de plus d'une décennie.

articles.t: GTA 6 Online: Is There Multiplayer at Launch? Everything Confirmed So Far
articles.chapeau: The upcoming arrival of GTA VI raises some concerns over the future of the series' online experience. Find out everything confirmed so far.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 will launch without an online multiplayer mode on November 19, 2026. Rockstar Games has confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player experience, meaning players should not expect a new version of GTA Online to be available on day one. However, a separate multiplayer experience could follow later. In September 2026, Twitch CEO Dan Clancy suggested that GTA 6's multiplayer could arrive in 2027, although Rockstar has not announced a release date or officially unveiled the mode.
For anyone wondering whether GTA 6 Online is coming, the distinction is important: the single-player release date is confirmed, while the timing and details of its potential online counterpart remain unconfirmed.
No. GTA 6 will be a single-player game at launch on November 19, 2026, with no confirmed online multiplayer mode available on release day. According to everything confirmed about GTA VI so far , Rockstar has officially listed PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as the game's launch platforms. Its announcement does not include a multiplayer launch date or a separate online edition.
This means players will initially experience the new crime saga through the main story, following protagonists Jason and Lucia in the fictional state of Leonida . Anyone hoping to jump straight into a shared open world with friends will have to wait for further announcements.
That does not mean Rockstar has ruled out multiplayer for the future. Rather, the company has yet to reveal when a successor to GTA Online will launch, what it will be called, or how it will connect to GTA 6 .
Three official sources in June 2026 established that GTA 6 is a single-player release.
First, Take-Two Interactive's June 24, 2026, official pre-order announcement explicitly described Grand Theft Auto VI as a single-player experience. The press release confirmed the November 19 launch date for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, alongside the start of pre-orders on June 25. The announcement also outlined the game's editions and pre-order bonuses, without announcing a multiplayer component.
Second, Rockstar reiterated the same information in its own June 24, 2026, pre-order announcement. The publisher stated that GTA 6 is a single-player experience and confirmed its arrival on November 19. This is the clearest official indication that the launch version should not be confused with the multiplayer offering that may follow.
Third, the PlayStation Store product information also describes GTA 6 as a single-player experience. This reinforces the distinction between the confirmed game available for pre-order and speculation about its online future.
Taken together, these statements leave little room for confusion about launch day: there is no officially announced GTA 6 Online mode launching alongside the main game. Rockstar has not provided a release date, gameplay details, or an official name for a future multiplayer component, not even on the official GTA 6 launch trailer .
While players wait for news about GTA 6's multiplayer future, the existing GTA Online remains the established destination for Rockstar's online crime sandbox.
Launched as the multiplayer component of Grand Theft Auto V , GTA Online's latest content update arrived long after the original game's release. The experience offers a persistent online world where players can build criminal enterprises, purchase properties and vehicles, take part in missions, and compete or cooperate with other players.
The continued existence of GTA Online also means there is no need to assume that its services will disappear when GTA 6 arrives. Rockstar has not announced that the current game will shut down on November 19, 2026, and GTA 6's single-player launch does not, by itself, imply an immediate end to the existing online experience.
For players already immersed in GTA Online , the practical takeaway is simple: the current game remains the confirmed multiplayer option while Rockstar keeps its plans for GTA 6's online component secret.

GTA 6 : le dirigeable Goodyear survole Vice City dans une nouvelle publication officielle 19-10-2026 18:20 DL GAMING
Le compte Instagram officiel du Goodyear Blimp a publié un message faisant référence à Vice City, la célèbre ville fictive de l’univers Grand Theft Auto. Avec la mention Vice City, Leonida, USA, accompagnée des emojis plage et crocodile ainsi que du hashtag GTA 6, cette publication joue directement avec l’univers du prochain jeu de Rockstar Games.
La publication a été partagée sur le compte vérifié @goodyearblimp, consacré au célèbre dirigeable publicitaire Goodyear. Son message est volontairement concis : une localisation fictive, Vice City, associée à Leonida, l’État dans lequel se déroule GTA 6, et une référence explicite au jeu.
Le clin d’œil est particulièrement parlant pour les fans de la franchise. Vice City constitue l’un des lieux emblématiques de Grand Theft Auto et revient au premier plan dans le prochain épisode de Rockstar Games. L’association avec Leonida reprend directement les noms utilisés pour présenter l’environnement de GTA 6.
Avec GTA 6, Rockstar Games emmène les joueurs dans l’État fictif de Leonida, qui accueille notamment Vice City. Cette dernière s’inspire de Miami et de la Floride, avec un univers marqué par les paysages côtiers, les zones urbaines et les marécages.
Les crocodiles et l’ambiance balnéaire évoqués dans la publication de Goodyear font ainsi écho à l’imagerie associée à cette région. Le message adopte les codes visuels et géographiques de GTA 6 pour proposer un clin d’œil immédiatement reconnaissable par la communauté.
En associant le nom de Vice City à celui de Leonida, le compte officiel du Goodyear Blimp s’inscrit dans la vague de références à l’univers du prochain Grand Theft Auto. Une publication courte, mais suffisamment explicite pour attirer l’attention des fans et rappeler l’attente qui entoure le jeu.
Reste à savoir si ce clin d’œil se limitera aux réseaux sociaux ou s’il s’inscrit dans une initiative plus large.

articles.t: Cyberleek drops new NSFW Lucia videos, threatens to release GTA 6 in full
articles.chapeau: Only about a month until the game is out.
articles.txt:
Notorious Grand Theft Auto VI leaker Cyberleek is back with a vengeance, it seems.
The anonymous video poster went dark after the big Netflix trailer in late August, but returned last week with a big, chunky 24-minute clip that featured story cutscenes, auto races, and the male protagonist Jason fully nude. Over the weekend and into Monday morning, Cyberleek shared some more clips that we won't link to, but can be easily found on social media. The new clips largely revolve around the female protagonist Lucia, and also show her completely nude, doing things like walking around Vice City or parachuting off a tall building.
In addition, Cyberleek posted a warning on their website claiming that if their memecoin reached a market cap of $30 million, they would release a video showing a full playthrough of the game's story prior to release. The same post also included a demand for publisher Take-Two to apologize for not releasing the game on disc and to rectify that issue. It is extremely unlikely the company could fire up disc manufacturing for GTA 6 in a timely fashion, even if the publisher wanted to negotiate with the leaker. At this point, there is no sign of that happening.
Just like in the videos featuring a nude Jason, the nude Lucia videos seem a little fishy in the sense that NPCs don't react to their nudity at all. Given that recent Rockstar games are built entirely around believable NPC interactions, that would suggest the nudity is not a regularly accessible feature in the final game and is being achieved through the use of developer tools.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' reportedly has realistic sweat. Here's how it works.
articles.chapeau: Of course it does.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games' games tend to be full of little details that players might barely notice (if at all), and it sounds like Grand Theft Auto VI is no different.
Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier published a deep dive into the development history of GTA 6 this week, complete with an accompanying YouTube video that explores key aspects of the story that didn't make it into print. One such aspect is a realistic sweat system that Rockstar apparently developed for the game. According to Schreier, protagonists Jason and Lucia will develop believable amounts of sweat depending on the physical activity they're doing.
Examples include working out in gyms or dancing in nightclubs. If you perform actions like that, Jason and Lucia will get a little moist, as you'd expect in the real world. Details like the sweat mechanic help explain why GTA 6 took nearly a decade to finish. It's also perfectly in character for Rockstar, as the company also previously developed a realistic horse testicle shrinkage system for cold weather in Red Dead Redemption II .

articles.txt:
(Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter While Roblox has been in the headlines plenty due to brainrot, doomscrolling games , and so on – other projects are catching a different kind of attention. Mainly because they don't look much like Roblox at all.
When I think of Roblox, I think of LEGO-shaped people with ridiculous smiles reminiscent of emojis – and children begging their parents for Robux, of course. I don't think of racing games that look closer to AAA titles, but perhaps I should. Over on X , a Roblox creator is sharing their in-progress project (that, yes, they're making on Roblox itself), and it's downright wild, from the lighting to the textures to the audio design, and you name it.
Dubbed Nightshift, it almost looks like Grand Theft Auto 6 or something – until you look at it more closely, that is. I've had a quick look around the project's official Discord , too, and the screenshots are just as incredible. It's all stunning supercars, left, right, and center, with folks helping shape the game via playtesting and the like. I'm not alone in thinking it's very cool, especially for a from-scratch Roblox-created project, either.
small sneakpeek of what we’ve made at L.U.M.E.N #roblox #robloxdev #gamedev https://t.co/AMFVyFb8HT October 14, 2026
Comments show as much, with one person simply asking, "How is this even possible?" Another says they "can't believe this is Roblox," which seems to be the common sentiment here. As a different reply puts it, "What the fuck, is this Roblox?" Indeed, it is, anon. Indeed, it is. Roblox has grown a good bit over time, evidently transforming into a sufficiently (and then some) capable tool for aspiring developers.
And, for fans questioning whether Nightshift will work on mobile devices seeing as it's, uh, quite ambitious, they don't need to worry. The poster, who is one of the developers heading the project, writes, "Mobile players will definitely be able to play this game!" Not only that, but "it's been a priority above PC since the very beginning of this game's development." A W for Roblox players using their phones and tablets, I suppose.

articles.t: With GTA 6's Dating System Incoming, a Surprising Percentage of Adults Think Investing in a Video Game Relationship Is Cheating
articles.chapeau: With GTA 6's Dating System Incoming, a Surprising Percentage of Adults Think Investing in a Video Game Relationship Is Cheating.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 is coming in November and focuses on a relationship between its dual protagonists, Jason and Lucia. The recent GTA 6 launch trailer featured three steamy intimate scenes in the shower, and, according to GTA 6 previews , Jason and Lucia can kiss at the touch of a button and are able to walk around holding hands. Screenshots suggest the pair can go on beach dates and shopping trips, and Rockstar has said that their relationship can blossom or wilt depending on how quickly you text back on the in-game mobile phones.
That Bonnie and Clyde-style relationship is at the center of Rockstar’s upcoming game, and you’ll be able to engage with it as much or as little as you want. But you might want to speak to your romantic partner in real life first.
In September, British polling company YouGov asked 4,000 British adults whether they’d consider dating in a video game as cheating or not. Around 6% of respondents said they would consider it cheating, while a further 19% said that while they didn't consider it cheating, they wouldn’t be okay with it.
That’s a fairly surprising number of people who think smashing pixels together is some kind of betrayal. Women were considerably more against it than men. Only 4% of men would consider it cheating, while 7% of women would. Of those that didn’t consider it cheating but still weren’t okay with it, that was 13% of the men and 24% of the women asked.
The BBC published an article on the poll, leading with a headline that was a question: can you cheat on someone with a video game character? This framing has led to a bit of backlash from players.
“No, video game characters are not real, get a grip ffs!” said Stetson Spatula . “Can you get arrested for murdering someone on call of duty?” asked another X / Twitter user .
A lot of the responses focused on established games such as The Sims, which let you live an alternative domestic life where your Sims marry, have children, and follow career paths while decking out their house. The perceived hypocrisy here is that players have been roleplaying relationships for a long time before GTA 6.
GTA 6's potential for "cheating," has come up before. In August, we reported on how a swath of angry spouses on social media said they thought GTA 6's relationship mechanic was so in depth that it was equivalent to cheating on your real-life partner and worth breaking up over. Over on TikTok, for example, a number of concerned people said they wouldn't let their partner to play the game.
Rockstar has also been very clear that you don't actually have to engage with this part of GTA 6 if you don't want to. Jason and Lucia want a relationship at the start of the game, but it's up to the player to actively pursue that. If you don't, they won't be as head-over-heels for each other, but will still have each other's backs when it matters most. If you do choose to make the two a power couple, you'll likely get more mileage out of the game, though.
"When you bring them together, it feels like you’re a steward of their relationship, and you feel protective of them as a unit," Rockstar North co-studio head, Rob Nelson, told IGN. "But this is something we did not know when we started, and it really had to be something we felt our way through. But I will say that whether you’re getting in trouble, or you’re running from the cops, or getting in a car, or waiting for the other one — playing as them together feels very cool. It feels like you’re taking care of them, if that’s something you’re into."
Rockstar is currently pushing hard on the marketing front ahead of next month’s release. Last week saw real cars modified to look like GTA vehicles being driven around Miami.

articles.t: The graphical glitch Rockstar could fix in GTA VI—one that has plagued its games for 18 years
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto VI could eliminate a graphical glitch that has been present since GTA 4. Digital Foundry discovers an improvement in the launch trailer.
articles.txt:
There’s exactly one month to go before Rockstar Games releases the most anticipated video game of the past decade, and everything points to this ambitious production marking a turning point for the studio in an aspect that had gone unnoticed by many players until now. Since the release of Grand Theft Auto IV in 2008, virtually all of its titles have shared a peculiar graphical flaw related to animations and camera movements . However, Digital Foundry has discovered that the latest trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI might be hiding a major piece of news right in plain sight: the glitch appears to have disappeared completely .
As reported by GamesRadar based on an analysis by Digital Foundry, Rockstar Games may have finally corrected one of the most persistent visual flaws in its video games . This is known as “animation stutter,” a problem that causes minor irregularities in the fluidity of character animations and camera movements. Although it can easily be mistaken for frame rate drops, it does not necessarily imply a reduction in frame rate, but rather an irregular presentation of movement that can create a sensation similar to jerky animation . This behavior has been observed in numerous titles developed with the RAGE engine , from Grand Theft Auto IV (2008) to Grand Theft Auto V (2013) and the two Red Dead Redemption games (2010 and 2018).
What’s truly interesting is that this flaw was also present in the early promotional materials for GTA 6 , including its trailers and the extensive gameplay demo released earlier. However, the experts at Digital Foundry believe that, after reviewing the most recent launch trailer, the game shows no apparent signs of the problem . This is particularly significant because the video includes numerous camera pans—precisely one of the situations in which these irregularities can be most evident.
Of course, this doesn’t necessarily mean that Rockstar has completely eliminated this glaring glitch . The studio may have carefully selected the footage shown in the trailer or applied some kind of additional processing to the promotional material. However, GamesRadar also points out that this hypothetical explanation is less convincing precisely because, in previous videos, this issue was visible without the company making the slightest attempt to hide it. On the other hand, Rockstar has recently acknowledged that it continues to make changes to the game even during the final weeks of development , so a technical fix of this nature would not be as surprising as one might expect under other circumstances.
In any case, we’ll have to wait until November 19, 2026 —the scheduled release date for Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and X box Series X|S —to see if this improvement is also present in the actual gameplay. Aside from its spectacular graphics, its vast open world, and its technical ambitions, Rockstar Games’ new title could achieve something that none of its major productions over the past two decades have managed: to fix a visual flaw that has been the target of criticism for much of the studio’s modern history .

articles.t: GTA 6 Is Getting Serious Competition on Nov. 12
articles.chapeau: An award-winning game port is due to hit the Nintendo Switch 2 amid November's hype.
articles.txt:
The wait is almost over for Grand Theft Auto fans: GTA 6 is due out on Nov. 19. It's been more than ten years since the last mainline GTA game ( Grand Theft Auto V came out in 2013), and fans have been eagerly anticipating a return to Vice City. Few games have drummed up as much anticipation as GTA 6 has, so some may think releasing a game in the same month — let alone the same week — would be toying with fate. But one game, set to release on Nov. 12, is ready to stand up against the GTA hype.
Metaphor: ReFantazio, an award-winning RPG from the creators of the Persona series, is set to arrive on the Nintendo Switch 2 on Nov. 12 — the same day that digital preloads of GTA 6 become available.
Artwork for the game Metaphor: ReFantazio , due out on the Nintendo Switch 2 in November. Image: Studio Zero The Nintendo Switch 2 version of Metaphor: ReFantazio is a port of Studio Zero's award-winning 2024 RPG. Upon its initial release, Metaphor: ReFantazio received international praise, including Best Roleplaying Game of the Year at the 2024 Game of the Year Awards and honors at the 2025 Japan Game Awards. The game holds a Metacritic score of 94 and was named Game of the Year by major outlets, including IGN and GameSpot.
For those of you who haven't played Metaphor: ReFantazio, it is set in the United Kingdom of Euchronia. The story opens with the assassination of the current king, and determining the next king isn't simply a matter of passing the torch. It calls for a Royal Tournament to be held, in which the next ruler will be chosen by the people. That's where you enter, playing as the game's main protagonist, a young boy named Will.
Polygon writer Chelsea Stark, in her 2024 review of the game , described Metaphor: ReFantazio as a "finely crafted triumph." "Every piece of Metaphor: ReFantazio’s art and visual design feels high touch. Characters stride about in brilliant outfits that highlight their tribe’s angel wings or dog tails. There are three styles of character animation — in-world animation, cel-shaded conversation, then a few fully animated sections to highlight the most show-stopping moments — and they’re all gorgeous," Stark wrote.
Metaphor: ReFantazio is available for $39.99 from Nintendo's website, and a demo of the game is already available to play.

Selon un article de GamesBeat, Rockstar Games viserait le premier trimestre 2027 pour porter son prochain blockbuster sur ordinateur, soit quelques mois seulement après sa sortie sur consoles. Une information qui reste toutefois à prendre avec précaution : le studio […]
articles.txt:
La version PC de Grand Theft Auto VI pourrait sortir bien plus rapidement que prévu. Selon un article de GamesBeat , Rockstar Games viserait le premier trimestre 2027 pour porter son prochain blockbuster sur ordinateur, soit quelques mois seulement après sa sortie sur consoles. Une information qui reste toutefois à prendre avec précaution : le studio n’a confirmé ni l’existence d’une version PC ni son calendrier de lancement.
Le rapport s’appuie sur quatre sources anonymes issues de l’industrie, présentées comme familières des plans de Rockstar. Si cette fenêtre se confirmait, l’écart entre les versions console et PC serait particulièrement réduit. GTA 6 est actuellement annoncé pour le 19 novembre 2026 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S, selon le site officiel de Rockstar. Une sortie PC avant la fin mars 2027 représenterait donc un délai d’environ quatre mois.
Ce scénario romprait avec les habitudes du studio. GTA 5 avait attendu près de dix-neuf mois avant d’arriver sur PC, tandis que Red Dead Redemption 2 avait nécessité environ un an. Rockstar privilégie traditionnellement les consoles lors du lancement de ses productions majeures, avant de proposer une version PC retravaillée, souvent accompagnée d’améliorations techniques.
Plusieurs facteurs pourraient néanmoins encourager une sortie plus rapide. Le marché PC occupe une place croissante dans l’industrie, et réduire le délai permettrait à Rockstar de profiter plus tôt d’une audience supplémentaire. Mais cette stratégie reste hypothétique : aucune annonce officielle ne vient étayer le calendrier rapporté par GamesBeat.
En attendant, les joueurs PC devront donc patienter sans date confirmée. Si cette rumeur se vérifie, GTA 6 pourrait toutefois faire exception à une tradition bien installée chez Rockstar. Pour l’heure, mieux vaut considérer le premier trimestre 2027 comme une possibilité, et non comme une échéance acquise.

articles.t: White House Joins GTA 6 Joke With Trump, a Flying Tesla and Marine One
articles.chapeau: The White House joined a GTA 6 meme with an image of Trump, a flying Tesla and Marine One following Tesla's futuristic Roadster reveal.
articles.txt:
By Ryan Thomas LaBee Published Oct 19, 2026, 9:16 AM EDT Sign in to your Military.com account President Donald Trump boards Marine One on the White House South Lawn on Oct. 6, 2026. Ten days later, the White House featured the presidential helicopter in a Grand Theft Auto VI-inspired meme about Tesla's flying-car demonstration (Molly Riley / White House. Public domain).
The White House has joined the internet's growing impatience over Grand Theft Auto VI , posting an image featuring President Donald Trump, a futuristic flying car and Marine One to celebrate Elon Musk's latest Tesla demonstration.
The official White House X account shared the image Friday, Oct. 16, with a caption familiar to anyone who has spent time waiting for Rockstar Games' next blockbuster.
The illustration shows Trump walking beside a hovering sports car while a helicopter resembling Marine One flies overhead. The artwork also incorporates the slogan "Make America Great Again" in lettering inspired by the Grand Theft Auto franchise.
It's the latest example of the administration borrowing imagery from popular video games for its official social media messaging.
The post followed Tesla's unveiling of its long-awaited second-generation Roadster on Oct. 15 at a SpaceX facility in Texas.
During the demonstration, the electric sports car used compressed-gas thrusters to launch itself into the air, perform a midair maneuver and land back on its wheels.
According to the Associated Press , the vehicle also accelerated from 0 to 60 mph in less than a second. However, anyone hoping to purchase a flying car will have to wait.
Tesla does not expect consumer production to begin until 2028, and the vehicle still faces substantial regulatory hurdles before it could legally operate on public roads.
Grand Theft Auto VI has also had a lengthy development cycle and multiple delays. Rockstar currently plans to release the game Nov. 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
The upcoming game returns players to Vice City and the fictional state of Leonida, following protagonists Jason and Lucia through a criminal conspiracy.
Including Marine One gives the gaming joke an unusual military connection.
Marine One is the call sign used whenever the president is aboard a Marine Corps aircraft. Marine Helicopter Squadron One, commonly known as HMX-1, operates presidential helicopters and is based at Marine Corps Base Quantico, Virginia.
According to the Marine Corps , the squadron has supported presidential helicopter transportation since 1957, when President Dwight D. Eisenhower began using helicopters to travel between locations.
President Donald Trump arrives on Marine One at the Ellipse near the White House, Friday, Aug. 21, 2026, in Washington. (AP Photo/Manuel Balce Ceneta) The administration has previously incorporated video game imagery into its communications. In March, the White House published a video combining footage of military strikes against Iran with clips from Top Gun , Halo and other entertainment properties, drawing scrutiny over its presentation of military operations.
The latest post focuses on a lighter subject: a flying-car demonstration and the seemingly endless wait for one of gaming's most anticipated releases. For now, Rockstar's game is scheduled to arrive more than a year before Tesla expects to begin producing its new Roadster for customers.

articles.t: 'GTA 6': Is PS5 Pro the best way to experience the game at launch?
articles.chapeau: Short answer: Probably?
articles.txt:
As we sift through the latest leaked gameplay videos for Grand Theft Auto VI , it's worth wondering: Which console will provide the most high-end experience when the game launches on Nov. 19?
The answer would usually be PC, but Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA 6 yet, and might not for a while. GTA V didn't launch on PC until two years later , after all. With that in mind, people are wondering if it's worth it to splurge on a PlayStation 5 Pro just to experience Vice City at the highest level of fidelity possible.
Rockstar has yet to share official visual and performance specs for any version of the game just yet, but let's investigate anyway with what little information we have.
This is the big question, and it's one we don't really have an answer to right now.
Rockstar's official marketing line for the last few months has been that GTA VI "plays best on PS5," but that tagline doesn't say anything about PS5 Pro. It also doesn't say much of anything in general, as we have no idea what the differences will be between the base PS5 and the Xbox Series X versions of GTA VI . It's not an exaggeration to say that we're operating with almost no useful information about the way this game performs on consoles right now, aside from the fact that the extended Netflix trailer was apparently captured on a base PS5.
There has been one recent little crumb of hope that the PS5 Pro version of the game is an upgrade over the base version, though. A recently released screenshot of a wet city street at night showcased high-quality reflections that don't seem to be present in the base PS5 build shown on Netflix or in any other marketing. Oliver Mackenzie of Digital Foundry , an outlet dedicated to technical analysis of game visuals, said on X that this screenshot may not represent regular PS5 gameplay.
Mackenzie estimates that these reflections use ray tracing, a relatively recent technology that generates real-time, high-quality lighting and reflections, while requiring a pretty intense amount of horsepower.
Base PS5 games technically can and do utilize ray tracing on occasion; the reflections in the Marvel's Spider-Man series on PS5 are a good go-to example. But given the extremely high level of graphical detail present in GTA 6 , it stands to reason that the game might not be able to use ray tracing on a base PS5, but could possibly include that feature on PS5 Pro.
It must be emphasized that this is all speculation based on one measly screenshot, which might not even show the console version of the game at all. Rockstar very well could have captured it using an internal PC build, as Mackenzie noted on X. But there is plenty of precedent for games like Ghost of Yotei locking the best ray tracing features behind PS5 Pro-exclusive modes, so it's possible GTA VI could do the same.
A PS5 Pro retails for $900 at the moment, and that's under the best of conditions, as a recent shortage has driven up the price on the secondary market considerably (as high as $1,300). It is perfectly reasonable to not want to spend that much money on a gaming device, no matter how powerful it is, and no matter how much better GTA 6 might look on it — emphasis on might .
But, as a PS5 Pro owner myself, I will say that games rarely (if ever) look or run worse on PS5 Pro, and big-budget AAA productions often benefit in some way from the added horsepower. A couple of my favorite games of this console generation, Dragon's Dogma 2 and Death Stranding 2 , look and perform absolutely wonderfully on PS5 Pro, just to provide two examples.
If you care about having the best graphics in every game, a PC is the way to go. But if you don't want a PC — or if the game you want to play isn't being released on PC for the foreseeable future — then the PS5 Pro is your second-best option. Just try not to spend too much more than $900 on it.
In the meantime, you can pre-order Grand Theft Auto VI for Xbox Series X/S and PS5 for $79.99.

articles.t: Mais au fait, ça veut dire quoi GTA ?
articles.chapeau: GTA n'est pas qu'une licence de jeux vidéo, c'est aussi un type de crime bien connu aux États-Unis. On vous explique.
articles.txt:
GTA n’est pas qu’une licence de jeux vidéo, c’est aussi un type de crime bien connu aux États-Unis. On vous explique.
GTA 6 par ci, GTA 6 par là. Oui, tout le monde en parle et les fans n’ont que ne nom à la bouche depuis un long moment déjà. Mais comment leur en vouloir maintenant, alors que le titre de Rockstar est attendu pour le 19 novembre prochain, dans un mois seulement. La tension monte, la médiatisation s’accélère et GTA 6 est sur toutes les lèvres. Il avait déjà l’avantage d’être le produit d’une franchise extrêmement populaire, même auprès du grand public.
Évidemment que tout le monde connait GTA, mais savez-vous au moins ce que ce nom signifie ? Les amateurs de la licence répondront aisément “Grand Theft Auto, trop facile”. D’accord, mais ça veut dire quoi ? On décrypte avec vous l’appellation d’un des jeux les plus populaires au monde mais dont on ne sait finalement pas grand chose.
En anglais, Grand Theft Auto se traduit littéralement par “ vol aggravé de voiture “, même si la traduction française la plus naturelle serait plutôt “v ol de véhicule “. Aux États-Unis, l’expression désigne le vol d’une automobile, généralement avec l’intention de priver son propriétaire de son bien. Attention toutefois car le droit américain varie selon les États, et grand theft auto n’est pas une infraction définie de manière identique sur tout le territoire.
En Californie, par exemple, le code pénal classe le vol d’une voiture parmi les cas de grand theft , indépendamment de sa valeur dans le texte de la loi. La distinction avec une simple utilisation non autorisée d’un véhicule repose notamment sur l’intention du voleur. Par exemple, emprunter une voiture sans permission et la voler pour de bon ne relèvent pas nécessairement de la même infraction.
Le titre de la franchise ne sort donc pas de nulle part. Il fait référence à un vrai type d’infraction, déjà niché au cœur de l’imaginaire des films policiers et des histoires de gangsters américaines des années 90 dont le jeu s’inspire largement. Quand le premier Grand Theft Auto sort en 1997, le titre résume parfaitement ce concept. Le joueur incarne un criminel qui évolue dans plusieurs villes fictives, accomplit des missions pour des organisations criminelles et accumule de l’argent et des points en semant le chaos. Le vol de voitures est évidemment une mécanique centrale du jeu.
Mais la franchise n’a pas tardé à élargir son terrain de jeu. Avec GTA : Vice City , le crime s’inscrit dans une histoire de pouvoir et de vengeance inspirée des films de gangsters. GTA : San Andreas ajoute une dimension plus large encore, avec des conflits de gangs, de la corruption et une ascension criminelle. Puis GTA V pousse encore plus loin le concept en suivant trois protagonistes aux profils très différents, entre des braquages spectaculaires, des règlements de comptes et une satire plus poussée de la société américaine. La voiture volée reste un symbole de la série, mais elle n’est plus qu’un élément parmi tant d’autres.
Aujourd’hui, réduire Grand Theft Auto à son nom serait donc passer à côté de ce qui fait son succès international. Les joueurs ne viennent pas seulement pour voler des véhicules, ils explorent des mondes ouverts, suivent des intrigues criminelles, découvrent des personnages mémorables et peuvent parfois passer des heures à faire tout autre chose que les missions principales. GTA 6 offrira même aux joueurs une gestion de la vie romantique du couple protagoniste, à la Bonnie et Clyde.
C’est un peu comme (feu) FIFA dont le nom renvoyait directement à la fédération internationale de football. La série a longtemps dépassé le cadre des compétitions organisées par cette institution, au point de devenir pour beaucoup un synonyme de jeu de football. Depuis, la franchise a d’ailleurs changé de nom pour devenir EA Sports FC . GTA suit une logique comparable. Son appellation rappelle ses origines, mais sa portée est désormais bien plus étendue.

articles.t: GTA 6 Is Wiping Out PS5 Pro Stock a Month Before Launch - CNET
articles.chapeau: The game's exclusivity is leading to greater demand for the high-end console.
articles.txt:
Rockstar’s extended look at Grand Theft Auto 6 aired in late August. Within a few weeks, the PlayStation 5 Pro was gone from every major US retailer. Buyers who want the best possible version of the year’s biggest game are gravitating to Sony’s top console, especially with no PC version planned for launch. A global memory chip shortage that’s raised hardware prices all year has made the squeeze worse, and Sony has warned retailers it’ll last into 2027.
Part of the reason for high console demand is that GTA 6 will be exclusive to PlayStation 5/Pro and Xbox Series X/S when it comes out on Nov. 19, and no other platforms have been announced yet.
In September, Sony reportedly advised distributors that the PlayStation 5 Pro would be in short supply until 2027, citing “temporary market supply constraints and high demand.” The most severe bottleneck limiting PlayStation distribution is a global crisis in memory and storage components driven by the AI infrastructure squeeze, or RAMageddon .
The PS 5 Pro promises better frame rates for a number of games as well as enhanced 4K processing, while the Rockstar Studios game is also designed to work on the “vanilla” PS5.
Yet, GTA 6 isn’t the only recent high-profile PlayStation release: The PS5-exclusive Wolverine — by the makers of Spider-Man and Spider-Man 2 — has reportedly sold 2.16 million copies since September.
The PlayStation 5 Pro debuted in November 2024 for $700, but its retail price has since increased to $900.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is the long-awaited sequel to Grand Theft Auto 5 , which first appeared in 2013. The crime-based game reportedly offers a playable area twice the size of the previous game’s. It’s available for preorder for $80.
Representatives for Sony didn’t respond immediately to CNET’s request for more information.

articles.t: Where to buy the PS5 Pro ahead of GTA 6 release
articles.chapeau: Scalpers are asking up to $1,700 for Sony's sold-out console ahead of the 'GTA 6' launch.
articles.txt:
You'll be hard-pressed to find a PlayStation 5 Pro in stock right now. Major retailers, including PlayStation Direct , Best Buy , Amazon (including bundle offers), Target , and Walmart , are sold out. With the upcoming release of Grand Theft Auto VI , the reseller market has gotten a little ridiculous (as has everything else).
Beyond the obvious hype for Rockstar's next release, Sony is dealing with broader supply chain bottlenecks. The global AI boom is squeezing the semiconductor market , which means Sony can't build consoles fast enough. According to distributor reports , these supply constraints could keep stock tight well into 2027.
Naturally, scalpers are having a field day. We've seen third-party listings on reseller sites (and even GameStop's official pre-owned page ) gouging buyers for $1,300 to $1,500+ for a console that retails for $899 . Sony is taking the issue so seriously that in Japan, they're forcing buyers to enter a lottery — and prove they've clocked at least 60 hours of PS4 or PS5 playtime over the last two years — just for a chance to buy a PS5 Pro.
If you absolutely have to buy one today and have money to burn, here's what the third-party market currently looks like:
Swappa: This is a legitimate, verified marketplace for used tech. However, verified PS5 Pro listings are currently sitting at $1,338.
StockX: The popular resale bidding site currently has the console hovering around $1,290.
Macy's and Walmart: Don't be fooled by third-party sellers on major retail sites. A low-rated seller on Walmart is currently asking $1,644.99 (open-box units are already sold out), while a third-party seller on Macy's is asking a staggering $1,749.99.
Mercari: We found a listing here for $800. Since this is $100 below the official MSRP for a highly coveted, sold-out item, it's almost certainly a scam. Avoid it.
If you're set on securing a Pro before launch day, here's how to play the restock game without burning a hole in your wallet:
Sign up for stock alerts. Restocks happen in small, sudden waves. Set up notifications through stock-tracking accounts on X (like @PS5StockUpdater ) or apps like HotStock to get pinged the second inventory hits.
Bookmark and refresh product pages. Keep direct product pages saved for PlayStation Direct , Best Buy , Amazon , Target , and Walmart . PlayStation Direct in particular occasionally drops invite-only or queue-based stock.
Check local inventory. Sometimes brick-and-mortar stores (like local GameStops or Target stores) receive small physical allocations that don't always show up online right away. It never hurts to ask an associate in person.
Preorder the game now. Don't hold your breath for a last-minute GTA 6 PS5 Pro console bundle. Secure your physical or digital preorder now so you're ready to go, no matter which console sits under your TV on day one.
The official retail price for a PS5 Pro is $899. If you see it listed for $1,300, $1,500, or more, you're looking at a third-party markup. Don't feed the scalpers.
Grand Theft Auto VI is currently scheduled to release November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
No, you definitely don't. Rockstar has confirmed that the game will run at 30fps on both the base PS5 and the Pro. Plus, Sony is bringing some of its newer AI upscaling technology to the base PS5 anyway, so you'll get a great visual experience on the standard hardware without spending $900.

articles.t: Après 18 ans, GTA 6 pourrait corriger un problème apparu dans presque tous les jeux Rockstar de GTA 4 à Red Dead Redemption 2
articles.chapeau: Présent dans de nombreux jeux Rockstar Games depuis le lancement de GTA 4, ce problème pourrait enfin avoir été corrigé par le studio si l’on en croit le dernier trailer de GTA 6.
articles.txt:
Présent dans de nombreux jeux Rockstar Games depuis le lancement de GTA 4, ce problème pourrait enfin avoir été corrigé par le studio si l’on en croit le dernier trailer de GTA 6.
Un mois, jour pour jour. C’est le temps qu’il nous reste à patienter jusqu’à la sortie officielle de GTA 6 qui, après des années d’attente, est enfin sur le point de faire son arrivée dans nos consoles. Un événement hautement attendu par des millions de joueurs, qui sont naturellement à l’affût du moindre petit détail sur ce qui nous attend dans ce futur opus. Et à en croire Digital Foundry, il se pourrait bien que celui-ci corrige enfin un problème que presque tous les jeux Rockstar Games, de GTA 4 à Red Dead Redemption 2 , présentaient depuis des années.
Le problème en question ? Les saccades dans les animations, que l’on ressent parfois dans les déplacements des personnages ou dans les mouvements de caméra, qui contribuent alors à donner un léger aspect « stop motion » aux productions de Rockstar selon le média. Mais comme le révèle ce dernier dans sa vidéo analyse du trailer 3 de GTA 6, dévoilé en fin de semaine dernière, il apparaît que, pour la première fois depuis très longtemps, le fameux problème n’est pas visible dans la vidéo. Et cela pourrait alors être une sacrée évolution.
Bien sûr, la plupart des joueurs n’ont probablement jamais eu conscience de cela, notamment compte tenu de la qualité des productions Rockstar en termes de réalisation. Mais pour des spécialistes au regard aussi affûté que ceux de Digital Foundry, la moindre petite saccade ne peut pas passer inaperçue. Et c’est d’ailleurs ce qui leur a permis de constater que le problème était toujours présent dans les premières vidéos de GTA 6, contrairement au dernier trailer en date qui en est étonnamment exempt du début à la fin.
Se pourrait-il, donc, que dix-huit ans après la sortie de GTA 4, Rockstar soit enfin venu à bout de ce petit défaut du moteur RAGE ? Ou est-ce un heureux hasard dû au fait que le trailer 3 ne présente que des séquences où les saccades ne sont pas présentes ? Dans l’immédiat, cela est évidemment difficile à dire avec certitude. Néanmoins, pour Digital Foundry, cela pourrait être le signe que depuis la présentation Netflix diffusée fin août, le studio a continué à peaufiner le titre au point de s’affranchir de ce problème présent depuis bientôt deux décennies maintenant.
Réponse définitive le 19 novembre prochain. En attendant, une chose est sûre : que le fameux problème soit présent ou non, GTA 6 n’aura aucun mal à s’imposer comme une claque technique et graphique , et pourrait même de nouveau contribuer à élever les standards des jeux en monde ouvert à la manière de Red Dead Redemption 2 en 2018. Car les dernières interviews de Rockstar se sont montrées très claires sur ce point, le studio n’a pas lésiné sur les efforts pour repousser toutes les limites possibles et imaginables en la matière.

articles.t: 13 Years Ago, Rockstar Suffered a Leak Worse Than GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Before unauthorized clips of GTA 6 scandalized fans, GTA 5 made video game leak history for Rockstar and Sony
articles.txt:
What could possibly be worse than footage of the world's most anticipated video game leaking onto the internet early , in an unfinished state? Easy. A game with a similar cultural footprint becoming playable ahead of its release. It seems unthinkable now in the age of Denuvo, but this exact nightmare scenario happened for Rockstar ahead of the release of Grand Theft Auto 5 .
The leaks began a few weeks before GTA 5 's official launch, after a snafu with the PlayStation Store allowed players with pre-orders to access some of the game's files. At first, the leaks didn't seem like such a big deal. The files told fans how much space the game would take up on their PS3 hard drives, and listed specific songs from the game's soundtrack. Another leak stemming from early strategy guides also showed players the game's map sooner than intended.
To be sure, the leaks didn't make anyone working on the game happy. A blog post from Rockstar said , “As you can imagine, we are deeply disappointed by leaks and spoilers being spread in advance of the game's launch. GTA V represents years of hard work by many people across the world, and we all couldn't be more excited to finally share it with you properly this September 17th.”
Sony, for its part, subsequently pulled the preload and apologized profusely to fans and Rockstar for the gaffe. Compared to the GTA 6 leaks, where players were able to see the main characters naked, this data breach sounds quaint. It's less common these days, but there are plenty of modern examples of major games being pirated early. Heck, nearly every big Nintendo game of the last generation was pirated well ahead of launch.
Back in 2013, however, digital games had just entered the mainstream — and leaks of this magnitude weren't a regular occurrence. The situation worsened quickly after players began sharing information about the game's story and ending. Rockstar and Sony alike had to warn players that they could be banned for spoiling the game early. While we've seen glimpses of GTA 6 's story and have some educated guesses about its ending , Rockstar has managed to keep such details under wraps so far.
Image: Rockstar Games None of these events were nearly as significant as what came after: the game was uploaded to torrent websites. This leak subsequently allowed people with jailbroken consoles to play the game early without paying for it. Can you imagine the chaos that would unfold if the same happened in GTA 6 ? A leaker merely threatening to release GTA 6 early has been called a "doomsday scenario."
The circumstances are wildly different, of course. The game that leaked in 2013 was, as far as anyone could tell, the finished experience — and it was pirated somewhat close to launch. The GTA 6 that's ostensibly being held hostage by Cyberleek may be an old build with accompanying dev tools. Rockstar doesn't plan on releasing GTA 6 on a physical disc , and it's unclear if the PC version will only be streamable. The consequences of a GTA 6 leak where players could poke at the game's files and see how the sausage was made are hard to predict.
A weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.
Phones and cameras also weren't nearly as good as they are now, so many of the leaks were shared in tiny, grainy pictures that were sometimes hard to make out.
"I don't know how 240p video even exists," one NeoGAF user complained .
Half of these leaks occurred on Vine, which doesn't even exist anymore. Meanwhile, GTA 6 's leaks show the protagonists fully nude in 4K .
Lucia Caminos using a punching bag in Grand Theft Auto 6 Rockstar Games/Take Two Interactive Some things are true in 2026 as they were in 2013, though. Years before they marveled at digital mud , fans couldn't believe how realistic GTA 5 looked.
"This could almost be a real live video footage," one Redditor remarked .
Most of all, nearly everyone hated watching the way other people played GTA. Either leakers are cursed to be bad video game players ... or no one is as good at GTA as they think.
"The dude was driving like an idiot," another NeoGAF user wrote .

articles.t: GTA 6 : fuite massive de 25 minutes de gameplay
articles.chapeau: Nouvelle fuite pour GTA 6 ! Découvrez 25 minutes de gameplay inédit à Vice City, les séquences avec Jason et Lucia et les détails de la sortie.
articles.txt:
Brève Il y a 11 j · Source : Cyberleek GTA 6 : une nouvelle fuite de 25 minutes montre Jason… entièrement nu L'essentiel › Une fuite inédite de 25 minutes de gameplay partagée par le leaker Cyberleek. › Des séquences spectaculaires à Vice City avec Jason et Lucia dans diverses situations. › Un aperçu de nouvelles mécaniques de conduite, de courses et de dialogues. Les fuites de GTA 6 continuent, et la dernière en date propose près de 25 minutes de gameplay inédit. Publiée par le leaker Cyberleek , la vidéo montre notamment Jason parcourant Vice City sans vêtements dans différentes séquences du jeu, y compris à moto, dans un café en bord de mer ou lors de dialogues avec d’autres personnages .
La vidéo laisse également entrevoir plusieurs éléments de gameplay . Jason apparaît notamment dans une course en moto tout-terrain après une cinématique avec Lucia, puis dans des séquences de conduite à la première personne et une course de rue. Lucia apparaît elle aussi brièvement dénudée dans une séquence située à la fin de la vidéo.
Certains passages pourraient par ailleurs contenir des spoilers liés à l’histoire. Cyberleek aurait notamment utilisé la vidéo pour promouvoir une cryptomonnaie, après avoir déjà diffusé plusieurs extraits de GTA 6 par le passé.
Rockstar Games avait précédemment qualifié les précédentes fuites de « déchirantes », tandis que Take-Two Interactive a engagé plusieurs procédures judiciaires afin d’identifier les personnes à l’origine des diffusions. En 2022, une fuite massive avait déjà dévoilé de nombreuses vidéos de gameplay et conduit à l’arrestation puis à la condamnation du pirate responsable.

articles.t: Cyberleek Threatens GTA 6 Build Leak Over Discs And An Apology
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek says a GTA 6 build leak will happen at a 30M market cap unless Take-Two ships physical discs and apologises. We look at what’s actually known.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 has spent years being picked apart by leakers, and now one of them is threatening to go much further than just sharing footage. Cyberleek has said on his website that he’ll release a playable build of the game to the public once he hits 30 million in market cap, as spotted in a post on r/GamingLeaksAndRumours . This GTA 6 build leak threat comes with conditions attached, and TakeTwo is the one being asked to meet them.
It is worth noting that none of this has been verified and there’s no confirmation that Cyberleek actually has a build, and neither Rockstar nor TakeTwo has responded publicly.
Cyberleek also acknowledged that the publisher probably assumes he’s bluffing and that’s a fair assumption on TakeTwo’s part, given that he hasn’t shown anything publicly that proves he has a build to release.
The market cap part is the strangest element. Market capitalisation usually refers to the total value of a company’s shares or a cryptocurrency token, but the post doesn’t say what asset this figure applies to, what currency it’s measured in or who controls it. Without that, it’s impossible to tell how close he is to the target, or whether the whole thing’s tied to some kind of token promotion.
The physical disc condition suggests Cyberleek is positioning himself as speaking for players rather than simply holding a game to ransom. The post doesn’t explain the reasoning, though, or what TakeTwo has done that he thinks warrants an apology.
Disc ownership has been a sore point across the industry for a while. More big releases are shipping as download codes or with only part of the game on the disc, and plenty of players see a physical copy as the only version they truly own. Whether that’s what’s driving this demand isn’t clear from what’s been shared.
If Cyberleek is bluffing, he’s picked a target where leaks are easy to believe. Rockstar’s history includes the 2022 breach that put early GTA 6 development footage online, and the hacker behind that is set to go back to court just days before the game launches . Older material keeps surfacing too, with stolen GTA 5 files revealing cancelled single-player expansions .
There’s a big difference between leaking video and leaking a working build, though. Footage spoils surprises. A build in the wild could be datamined for every mission, map area and system Rockstar’s spent years developing, and it’d give cheat makers a head start before the game even goes on sale.
For anyone on PC hoping a leak means getting hands on GTA 6 early, it’s worth being sceptical. Supposed leaked builds of huge games are a common lure for malware, because people are willing to download large archives from unknown sources and run whatever’s inside.
Even if a genuine build did appear, there’s no indication of what platform it’d be for or how complete it’d be. Development builds are often unstable, unoptimised and tied to specific hardware or tools, so it’s far from guaranteed anyone could run one on a normal gaming PC.
If something does surface claiming to be GTA 6, the safest move is to leave it alone. A compromised system isn’t a fair trade for an early look at a game that’s coming anyway. For now, this looks more like an attention grab than a credible threat, especially with that unexplained market cap target attached.
Do you think Cyberleek actually has a build, or is this a bluff aimed at hype? Let’s know your thoughts in the comments.

articles.chapeau: Une affiche repérée dans un magasin GameStop affirme que les versions physiques de GTA 6 incluront une carte collector. Rien d’officiel pour l’instant.
articles.txt:
Une affiche repérée dans un magasin GameStop affirme que les versions physiques de GTA 6 incluront une carte collector. Rien d’officiel pour l’instant.
Le plus important, là, c’est simple. Une nouvelle fuite autour de GTA 6 affirme qu’une carte collector physique serait glissée dans chaque copie physique du jeu. Sauf qu’on ne l’a pas vue, et personne n’a encore validé ça noir sur blanc.
Ce qui circule en ligne ne montre pas la carte elle-même. Juste son existence supposée. L’idée, c’est que les éditions physiques de GTA 6 incluraient une carte collector, ce qui parle forcément aux joueurs qui aiment les bonus tangibles, ceux qu’on garde après avoir refermé la boîte.
Mais il y a un vrai trou dans l’histoire. On ne sait pas à quoi ressemble cette carte, ni ce qu’elle contient exactement. Pas de visuel, pas de détail, pas de confirmation. Résultat ? Pour l’instant, c’est une info qui excite pas mal de monde, mais qui reste très incomplète.
L’origine de la fuite est assez précise. Un post apparu sur le Reddit consacré à GTA 6 montre ce qui ressemble à une publicité bricolée, affichée sur la vitrine d’un magasin GameStop . Le lieu exact du magasin n’a pas été révélé.
Ensuite, la machine s’est emballée. Le post a été repris par des comptes bien connus de la sphère Grand Theft Auto sur X et ailleurs, ce qui a suffi à faire remonter l’info très vite.
Le détail qui change un peu la donne, c’est que la personne ayant partagé le post dit être entrée dans le magasin et avoir parlé aux employés. D’après elle, ils auraient répété la même information. C’est intéressant, clairement. Ce n’est toujours pas une preuve définitive.
Ni GameStop ni qui que ce soit d’officiel n’a communiqué là-dessus. Et ça, ça pèse lourd. L’information aurait seulement fait surface dans certains magasins, pas via une annonce large et carrée.
Bon, on a donc une fuite plausible, un support physique aperçu en boutique, et un relais massif sur les réseaux. Mais on n’a pas la pièce maîtresse, une confirmation officielle. Tant qu’elle n’arrive pas, cette histoire de carte collector reste un bonus possible, pas une promesse gravée dans le marbre.
Pour les fans de GTA 6 , ça suffit à surveiller le dossier de près. Pas à précommander les yeux fermés.

GTA 6 fans spot mysterious detail at 0:55 in new trailer Anand Sinha Fri, October 16, 2026 at 3:04 PM CDT 4 min read On Oct. 15, Rockstar Games published the much-anticipated launch trailer for the Grand Theft Auto VI . The game, which has been in production for than 8 years, finally gave fans a glimpse of what to expect.
The thrilling trailer has already generated more than 26.3 million views on YouTube. But there is one mysterious detail that has caught the attention of fans on X, Reddit, and Instagram.
With an estimated budget of $1 billion-$2 billion , the GTA 6 has taken more than a decade to make and can be counted among the most enduring pop culture phenomena. The game is scheduled to launch on Nov. 19.
The 90-second trailer follows the game's protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, driving around the streets of the fictional U.S. state of Leonida. The couple are seen flirting, romancing, and having a lot of fun while getting chased down by law enforcement agencies.
Around 00:55 seconds, the GTA 6 trailer features the logo of Dacity Coin pasted on the side of an aircraft.
When a Reddit user posted a screenshot from the trailer showing the coin on the GTAVI sub, fans shared some wild theories.
The original poster Odd_West5719 wondered if the game would feature a cryptocurrency .
In simple words, a cryptocurrency is a digital currency that relies on cryptography to secure transactions and is created on a distributed online ledger called blockchain .
A distributed ledger means no central body creates or controls the financial records; it's only after multiple contributors (nodes) spread across the world reach a consensus that a transaction is confirmed.
When the first cryptocurrency, Bitcoin (BTC), was launched in 2009, it was mocked for its purported ambition to take on Wall Street.
Memes mocking the early enthusiasm for crypto birthed meme coins — a type of cryptocurrency that was built on the same blockchain technology but never pretended to have any utility except mocking cryptocurrencies.
Today, Bitcoin's market cap is worth $1.65 trillion. If BTC were a company, it would be ranked among the world's top 10 companies.
Some of the meme coins like Dogecoin (DOGE) have also become extremely popular, thanks to support from tycoons like Elon Musk .

Analyst issues sarcastic response to 31.4% crypto tax expansion plan
Responding to the Reddit post, one user commented that the game will mock "crypto bros" and another wondered about the game possibly having a storyline around a rug pull — a kind of scam.
GTA Wiki, the X page of the fan-based platform that shares detailed information on the game's trivia, claimed Dacity Coin is a cryptocurrency in the game that gets promoted through publicity stunts.
"I think that's Jason and Lucia doing a side hustle," a fan quipped.
An Instagram handle called Page Z also wondered if the fictional cryptocurrency potentially hints at scams within the game.
GTA Wiki, the fan-based database, describes Dacity Coin as a fictional cryptocurrency created by AudaCity, a brand due to appear in the upcoming game.
As per GTA Wiki, Dacity Coin was first mentioned in the Oct. 11 leak which showed Lucia being asked to advertise AudaCity through a parachuting stunt in Vice City to raise money for the coin.
As reported earlier , an individual or a group called CyberLeek has been leaking GTA 6's original footage for months now and collecting money through an eponymous meme coin.
The coin has faced scam accusations , which CyberLeek has sought to deny by burning coins .
The whole controversy only shows the prevalence of crypto scams.
As per the onchain analytics platform TRM Labs , illicit crypto volume hit a record $158 billion in 2025, up nearly 145% from 2024. However, illicit volume as a proportion of overall volume fell from 1.3% in 2024 to 1.2% in 2025.

articles.t: GTA 6 is eyeing Lucia as the next Arthur Morgan; here's why
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games believes the new GTA heroine will 'stand tall' as the greatest gaming character ever created!
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games believes the new GTA heroine will 'stand tall' as the greatest gaming character they've ever created.
Taking over the mantle from Trevor, Franklin and Michael, the power duo of Lucia and Jason are quickly being examined by every Grand Theft Auto fan, as the Bonnie and Clyde protagonists hold the key to GTA 6 being the greatest game of all time.
Already, the two lead characters are kicking up a fuss, as the motivations behind their actions are being subjected to wild theories .
But Rockstar is going all in on framing the duo as a powerhouse team, as seen in the launch trailer , which was released on October 15.
In a frantic 90-second, action-heavy clip, the trailer consistently showcased Lucia's standalone personality, split only by steamy shower scenes that confirmed that the nude gameplay leaks were true.
With the new heroine set to take control of the GTA 6 narrative, Lucia is now being tipped to be the outright main character, and Rockstar is already putting her on a podium of the highest expectations.
Having championed a number of protagonists in a portfolio of colossal games, Rockstar Games has revealed that Lucia is their number one choice to be the face of the studio for the next generation, taking over from Arthur Morgan.
Of course, that's high praise, as Morgan is widely considered to be one of the best characters ever made, possibly the single greatest video game protagonist outside the likes of Nintendo's Mario.
At the very least, Morgan is regarded as the best of Rockstar Games, and that bar is set to be raised by Lucia,
Speaking in an interview with LOVE Magazine , Rockstar Games writer Alexa D'Agostino claimed that Lucia is the main driving force behind a lot of the decisions made in the storyline, often being overly naive, fearless and ambitious.
"Lucia had to be someone who wanted a better life for herself, and wouldn’t let the obstacles in the way of that life stop her getting it," she said.
"There are many badass women like her, just as there are many men like Jason. We just focused on capturing that.
"When you are focusing on writing a fully realized person with their own wants, you’re getting to get something perfectly imperfect, with clichés, but also undeniably real. That’s how you get a woman that can stand tall next to the likes of Arthur Morgan and Niko Bellic."
Read Next: GTA 6 leaker threatens to drop entire game as 6 new features confirmed in Lucia gameplay
Even the inclusion of Niko Bellic is an extremely high bar, as the Grand Theft Auto IV legend is often hailed as the pinnacle of the franchise, having been awarded a bigger role than the GTA V trio who shared responsibilities.
If we're projecting expectations, even matching John Marston from the original Red Dead Redemption would be enough for Lucia to spearhead GTA 6 to its perch as the greatest game of all time, leaving Jason to tip it over the edge.
The worry is that Jason's personality is rather bland, though, following his partner in crime at every turn, rather than having his own leads - that is, unless the popular dual-personality theory comes true...
Still, Lucia is the queen we'll be following moving forward, and if she's anything like what Rockstar is claiming, we're in for a huge treat.

articles.chapeau: Rockstar released the launch trailer for GTA VI, revealing a potential meme coin in the upcoming game and sending degens wild.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 Trailer Features Meme Coin—And Solana Copycat Soars 2,900% Ryan Gladwin Fri, October 16, 2026 at 5:16 AM CDT 4 min read SOL-USD +2.27% PUMP36507-USD +6.98% Two seconds of the Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer was all it took for a Solana meme coin to fly, making some traders pretty rich.
Dacity Coin was seen plastered along the side of a plane in the GTA 6 launch trailer released on Thursday, with a man setting off a neon pink flare on the wing. This prompted a real meme coin of the same name to skyrocket 2,900% from a $104,000 market capitalization to $3.18 million, in the hour following the trailer's release.
Interestingly, the token had been created five days prior, after notorious Rockstar hacker "Cyberleek" leaked GTA 6 gameplay revealing that Dacity Coin was set to be in the game—but only a comparatively small group of traders noticed.
Upon its October 11 launch on Solana launchpad Pump.fun , Dacity Coin hit a peak market cap of $1.14 million before falling to $144,700 over the coming day and trading sideways until Thursday's sharp rise.
As a result, traders had plenty of time to buy into the meme coin before it skyrocketed. According to DEX Screener, 24 traders profited more than $10,000 on the token, with the top trader turning $1,912 into $44,000.
Dacity now sits at a $1.5 million market cap, dropping around 53% from its $3.18 million peak.
In the launch trailer, the plane reads "DacityCoin AudaCity," and in previously leaked footage, the game's protagonist Lucia can be seen skydiving wearing an AudaCity parachute. When the parachute opens, per the leaked screenshots, it features the slogan "Quit your job. Sell your house. Move [ineligible]."
According to the GTA wiki, Lucia is asked to parachute as a stunt to advertise the AudaCity brand and attract investment to the Dacity Coin.
If true, the game appears to be satirizing the stunts that meme coin creators have performed to promote their tokens over the years. In 2024, Decrypt reported that a man set himself on fire to promote his meme coin while others smoked drugs on livestream, pretended to be a dog, or recklessly shot a pistol out of their window.
This falls on the backdrop of years-long rumours of cryptocurrencies featuring in GTA 6. Several theories were thrown out, including play-to-earn features, NFT-owned properties, and even an entire blockchain for the game. However, all of them were unsubstantiated—Dacity Coin is the first solid sign of cryptocurrency being in the upcoming game.
How prominent will Dacity Coin be in the upcoming GTA 6 game? That's the question currently on the lips of traders. If it's a mainstay of the game, then degens might stand to profit handsomely from holding the token for longer. If not, well, this might be the end of the road.
In February 2025, Fortnite added a fake crypto coin called Dill Bits, and degens quickly launched a real one on Solana that hit a $4.78 million market cap before crashing 96%. It pumped 2,700% again in April after Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney called it a scam , then dropped 82% within days.
"I didn't launch it. What is wrong with you people," Sweeney posted, as traders floated theories that he was secretly behind the coin.
The Dill Bits community took the whole thing as bullish, given that Fortnite's storyline was literally about a pickle villain called Big Dill running a crypto rug pull. It didn't help much, with DB dropping 82.3% in the days that followed.
Epic Games told Decrypt at the time that there was "no real cryptocurrency or memecoin associated with Fortnite or endorsed by Epic."
Rockstar has yet to say anything about Dacity Coin, and the game studio did not respond to Decrypt 's request for comment.

A few days later, the leaker said they wouldn't leak GTA 6's ending if Take-Two left them alone.
On August 18, an unidentified person or group going by the name "Cyberleek" began sharing what appeared to be Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay clips on the internet.
The internet was naturally skeptical, but the footage was hard to fault: It looked authentic, showing mundane GTA 6 gameplay featuring its male protagonist, Jason. In one clip the player shot a basketball outside of the same house we've seen in the trailers, and in another he did some typical GTA random-civilian-murdering.
A day later, Cyberleek dropped two more videos , both of which also looked legit. At the same time, the clips were being stricken from social media on copyright grounds—the only public response from Take-Two and Rockstar so far.
The fifth video Cyberleek released ended with a twist: the player writing the word "LEEK" into the side of a building with bullet holes. These are not, it turns out, clips taken by GTA 6 testers and found on an unsecured server, as many assumed. Cyberleek has (or had) access to a build of GTA 6 , or a portion of it.
We don't know exactly how Cyberleek is getting their clips. The footage of them shooting "LEEK" into a wall indicates they have or had access to a playable build, but it is not necessarily the full game. It's notable that GTA 6's other protagonist, Lucia, has not shown up in the clips.
It does seem that these clips are from a relatively recent build, however. In one of the clips, the in-game radio is playing "Sports Car" by Tate McRae, which released in January 2025.
